name: context-menu
title: ContextMenu
description: A right-click menu positioned at the pointer. Opens on contextmenu over the wrapped target, clamps to the viewport, closes on outside-click, Escape or selection. Arrow keys move between items. Distinct from <Dropdown> (a left-click trigger button).
docs: Part of the AI Design System. Its full contract — every prop, its allowed values and what each one means — is at https://github.com/axdes/AI-Design-system/blob/main/registry/ContextMenu.json
